definitions.explanation: The youngest daughter in a family. Often carries connotations of being spoiled or pampered, as the baby of the family.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}が{結婚|けっこん}した。
{三人|さんにん}{姉妹|しまい}の{末娘|すえむすめ}として{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: She grew up as the youngest of three sisters.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}は{家族|かぞく}みんなに{可愛|かわい}がられて{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: The youngest daughter was raised being doted on by the whole family.

notes: Combines {末|すえ} (end, last) + {娘|むすめ} (daughter). The male equivalent is {末息子|すえむすこ} (youngest son). The general term for the youngest child regardless of gender is {末|すえ}っ{子|こ}. Related family terms: {長女|ちょうじょ} (eldest daughter), {次女|じじょ} (second daughter), {三女|さんじょ} (third daughter).
